title: lagenocarpus dioicus
intro: Lagenocarpus dioicus, commonly known as the Cattley guava, is a type of plant species in the genus Lagenocarpus. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Lagenocarpus dioicus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Lagenocarpus dioicus may also have anti-cancer and anti-diabetic properties, although more research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
